aboutPage.title: A little about me
aboutPage.subtitle: Developer and lifelong learner — here's the story behind the code.
intro: I'm Sunny — a full-stack developer who genuinely enjoys turning ideas into clean, fast, and reliable products. My journey started with curiosity about how the web works, and somewhere along the way that curiosity turned into a craft.

I love the whole stack — designing intuitive interfaces with React and Next.js, shaping robust APIs with Node.js and TypeScript, and modeling data thoughtfully with PostgreSQL or MongoDB. I care about details: how a button feels, how a query scales, how a codebase reads six months later.
Outside of work I'm always tinkering — picking up new tools, breaking things on purpose, and rebuilding them better. I believe the best engineers stay curious, ship often, and never stop learning.
funFacts: I love side projects more than tutorials.
